old: Describing national flags and emblems utilizes verbs of representation: *szimbolizál vmit* ('symbolizes sth'), *jelképezi az erőt* ('represents strength' - accusative), *kifejezi a nemzet hűségét* ('expresses the fidelity of the nation').
new: You know the accusative *-t* from earlier units. Here it follows verbs of representation: *szimbolizál vmit* ('symbolises sth'), *jelképezi az erőt* ('represents strength'), *kifejezi a nemzet hűségét* ('expresses the fidelity of the nation'). By tradition, red means strength, white fidelity and green hope.
